title: He beat Big Tobacco. Will the same playbook work against Meta and social media?
summary: Legal expert Mike Moore's strategy against Big Tobacco is being examined as a potential template for regulatory action against Meta and social media platforms. The question centers on whether antitrust and public health arguments that succeeded in tobacco litigation can translate to the tech industry.
content: Mike Moore beat Big Tobacco. Will the same playbook work against Meta and social media?

zh.title: 他击败了大烟草公司。同样的策略对Meta和社交媒体能否奏效？

title: Here are the 3 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead
summary: Investors should focus on upcoming earnings reports from Broadcom and Palo Alto Networks alongside the week's jobs economic data release. These developments could significantly influence market direction in the coming week.

summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent is navigating complex diplomatic negotiations at the G20 while managing multiple economic challenges including tariff policies, Middle East tensions, and bond market volatility. The role requires balancing international relations with domestic economic stability.

zh.title: 美国财政部长贝森特在关税、伊朗战争和债券混乱中面临G20外交考验
zh.summary: 美国财政部长贝森特正在G20进行复杂的外交谈判，同时应对多项经济挑战，包括关税政策、中东紧张局势和债券市场波动。这一角色需要平衡国际关系与国内经济稳定。

title: I'm a psychologist who studies couples: The happiest couples never fight about this 1 thing (it's not sex or money)
summary: Relationship psychologist Mark Travers identifies household labor and contribution inequality—not sex or finances—as the key conflict area for couples. Research suggests that couples who resolve disputes about fairness in daily responsibilities tend to report higher relationship satisfaction.
content: Psychologist and relationship expert Mark Travers says the happiest couples have stopped fighting about who's doing more. Here's how to avoid it.

zh.title: 我是婚姻心理学家：最幸福的夫妻从不为这一件事争吵（不是关于性或金钱）
zh.summary: 婚姻关系心理学家马克·特拉弗斯指出，家务分工和贡献不平等——而不是性或财务——是夫妻之间的主要冲突领域。研究表明，能够化解关于日常责任公平性分歧的夫妻往往报告更高的关系满意度。

title: What new tariff walls in U.S.-Canada trade war mean for the economy's critical metals
summary: U.S.-Canada trade tensions have triggered immediate repricing in metals and materials markets, with stocks and ETFs reflecting the new tariff environment. Long-term investors should exercise caution, as critical metals supply chains face disruption from escalating trade barriers.
content: When the U.S.-Canada trade war erupted, the market repriced metals and materials stocks and ETFs, but longer-term investors should be wary.

zh.title: 美加贸易战中的新关税壁垒对经济关键金属意味着什么
zh.summary: 美加贸易紧张引发了金属和材料市场的立即重新定价，股票和交易所交易基金反映了新的关税环境。长期投资者应该谨慎，因为关键金属供应链面临不断升级的贸易壁垒带来的中断。

title: These charts show how leverage-happy investors are transforming the stock market
summary: A wave of retail investors and algorithmic trading funds has driven increased use of leverage and short-term trading strategies in the stock market. This structural shift toward borrowed capital and faster trading cycles could heighten market volatility and systemic risk.
content: A rush of retail investors and quant funds has caused a shift toward more borrowed money and more short-term trading.

zh.title: 这些图表展示了杠杆青睐的投资者如何改变股市
zh.summary: 散户投资者和算法交易基金的浪潮推动了股市中杠杆和短期交易策略使用的增加。这种向借入资本和更快交易周期的结构性转变可能会加剧市场波动和系统性风险。

title: Rescuers race to find thousands missing after Nepal-China glacier collapse
summary: Rescue operations are underway in Nepal and China following a catastrophic glacier collapse that has left thousands reported missing. The disaster underscores the region's vulnerability to climate-driven environmental hazards and challenges in coordinating large-scale rescue efforts in mountainous terrain.

zh.title: 尼泊尔-中国冰川崩塌失踪数千人，营救队争分夺秒搜救
zh.summary: 尼泊尔和中国正在进行救援行动，一场灾难性的冰川崩塌导致数千人失踪。这场灾难凸显了该地区对气候驱动的环境灾害的脆弱性，以及在山区协调大规模救援行动的挑战。

title: Icelanders reject reopening talks to join the EU despite Trump's Greenland threats
summary: Icelandic voters rejected a proposal to restart accession negotiations with the European Union in a narrow referendum, voting 52.8% against with 47.2% in favor. The vote suggests Icelanders remain largely committed to their independent status despite recent geopolitical tensions.
content: Icelanders voted 52.8% to 47.2% against reopening talks to join the European Union.

zh.title: 尽管特朗普对格陵兰岛发出威胁，冰岛人仍拒绝重启欧盟入盟谈判
zh.summary: 冰岛选民在一次接近的公投中拒绝了重启与欧盟入盟谈判的提议，52.8%反对，47.2%赞成。这次投票表明，尽管最近地缘政治局势紧张，冰岛人在很大程度上仍然致力于维持独立地位。

title: NASA's newest space telescope launches on a quest to explore the hidden universe
summary: NASA has launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, named after the agency's first chief astronomer, on a mission to observe distant galaxies and phenomena invisible to current instruments. The bus-sized observatory requires more than three months to reach its operational position.
content: The bus-sized telescope — named after the late Nancy Grace Roman, NASA's first chief astronomer — will take more than three months to reach its destination.

zh.title: 美国宇航局最新太空望远镜发射，探索隐藏的宇宙
zh.summary: 美国宇航局发射了以该机构首位首席天文学家命名的南希·格蕾斯·罗曼空间望远镜，其使命是观察遥远星系和现有仪器看不到的现象。这个公交车大小的天文台需要三个多月的时间才能到达其运作位置。

title: Party balloons could become a ‘luxury’ as the Iran war spurs a helium shortage
summary: Helium supply constraints linked to the Iran conflict have begun impacting party supplies, with retailers like Dollar Tree reporting declining balloon sales. The shortage threatens to inflate costs across multiple industries reliant on helium, from medical devices to semiconductor manufacturing.
content: Dollar Tree says a helium squeeze has hit sales of balloons and party supplies. Researchers note this could foreshadow higher costs for other industries that depend on the gas.

zh.title: 随着伊朗战争引发氦气短缺，派对气球可能成为"奢侈品"

title: The 'choose your own adventure' earnings: Why retailers are handling tariff refunds so differently
summary: Retailers are approaching tariff refund windfalls in divergent ways, with some passing savings directly to consumers through price reductions while others absorb the gains to improve profit margins. This inconsistency reflects different strategic choices about prioritizing customer value versus shareholder returns.
content: Retailers have diverged on how they've reported tariff refunds in their earnings this quarter, with some choosing to lower prices and others boosting margins.
